load_package = function(package = NULL){
    if(!requireNamespace(package, quietly = T)){
        message("Installing", package, "....")
        install.packages(package)} 
    library(package, character.only = T)
    message(package, " loaded successfully.")
}

Bin Age

50 - 59, 60 - 69, 70+

frailty = frailty %>% 
  mutate(age_2020_bin = case_when(age_2020 >= 50 & age_2020 <= 59 ~ "50-59",
                                  age_2020 >= 60 & age_2020 <= 69 ~ "60-69",
                                  age_2020 >= 70 ~ "70+",
                                  .default = "less than 50"))


frail_age_2020_tbl =  frailty %>% 
  filter(is_frail == "Frail",
         age_2020_bin != "less than 50") %>% 
  select(crp_cat, age_2020_bin) %>% table()

frail_age_2020_tbl %>% kable(caption = "Frail Individuals by Age at 2020 and CRP Test Status")
Frail Individuals by Age at 2020 and CRP Test Status

no crp 837 1633 2085
normal crp 124 209 268
elevated crp 265 452 456

          xlab = "Age at 2020")
age_2020 = frailty %>% select(age_2020_bin, crp_cat, is_frail) %>% 
  filter(age_2020_bin != "less than 50")


save_age_tbl = tabyl(age_2020, age_2020_bin, crp_cat, is_frail) %>%
  adorn_totals(c("row","col")) %>% 
  adorn_percentages("row") %>%
  adorn_pct_formatting(digits = 2) %>% 
  adorn_ns() 

kable(save_age_tbl$`Not Frail`, caption = "Not Frail Individuals by Age at 2020 and CRP Test Status")

frailty = frailty %>% 
  mutate(age_2020_bin = factor(age_2020_bin, levels = c("less than 50", "50-59", "60-69", "70+")))

frail_prop = frailty %>% filter(age_2020_bin != "less than 50") %>% 
  summarise(count = n(),
            .by = c(is_frail, age_2020_bin,
                    crp_cat)) %>% 
  mutate(total = sum(count),
         proportion = count / total) %>% 
  ungroup()

wide =   frail_prop %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = is_frail,
                            names_from = c(age_2020_bin, crp_cat),
                            values_from = proportion,
                            names_sort = T)
total = wide %>% summarise(across(-is_frail, sum)) %>% 
  mutate(is_frail = "Total")

total_age = bind_rows(wide, total) %>% 
  mutate(across(-is_frail, ~ scales::percent(.)))

total_age %>% kable()
